verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is a developer platform, and such platforms could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows APIs for running code in isolated containers (exec, files, interpreter, sessions). It is positioned as infrastructure for building your own AI agents, which is a developer building block rather than a built-in assistant the user can delegate tasks to. No evidence of a built-in assistant exists in the pack.
